up: Retrieve exact IC50 activity values (in nM) for compounds tested against human Amine oxidase [flavin-containing] A. For each activity record, provide the compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, PubMed ID or DOI (prefer PubMed ID), assay description, and target details. Only include records where the compound has a canonical SMILES and the associated document has a PubMed ID or DOI.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism AS target_organism,
  a.standard_value AS ic50_nM
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE
  td.pref_name = 'Amine oxidase [flavin-containing] A'
  AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
  AND (d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR d.doi IS NOT NULL);
